name: project_visual_media_gallery_photo
title: Project Visual Media Gallery - Photo
description: Photo part of a project's visual media: title (block_title, default "Photo Media Content") + photo galleries from src/content/img/projects/<media.path>/media/ (project_media_gallery "images", one list per folder, id "photo"). Renders nothing (no title) when there are no images. Used by project_visual_media_gallery, can also be placed on its own.
